model_annotation: This figure presents a line chart comparing the performance of three methods—Teacher, Self-Training, and a third method whose label is partially cut off (appearing to begin with "PST" or similar), shown in green with circular markers. The x-axis and y-axis labels and tick values are not visible in the image due to cropping, making it impossible to identify exact units, ranges, or intervals for either axis. Three lines are plotted across the chart. The red line with diamond-shaped markers, labeled "Teacher," starts at a high value on the left side of the chart, remains relatively stable with a slight dip and recovery over the first few data points, then decreases steadily across the remaining x-axis range, dropping sharply toward the right end of the chart. The blue line with square markers, labeled "Self-Training," begins at approximately the same high value as the red line on the far left, follows a similar pattern of slight fluctuation in the early portion, then declines more steeply than the red line through the middle and right portions, ultimately reaching the lowest values at the far right. The green line with circular markers, representing the partially obscured third method, starts slightly below the other two lines on the left, then rises to a plateau that remains relatively flat and higher than both other lines through the middle portion of the x-axis, before declining toward the right side, though it maintains higher values than both the red and blue lines across most of the chart until converging downward at the far right.
